521:t_006:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have no intention of risking my life on a battlefield that's still only a preliminary engagement.」

521:t_007:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Colonel, fall back! I'll handle this!」

521:t_007:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$! You're still doing this!?」

521:t_007:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ・リンクス$$! The Colonel is everything to me!」

521:t_007:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You wouldn't understand! The Colonel saved me from darkness so deep I thought being born had been a mistake!」

521:t_007:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Blindly believing in $$フル・フロンタル$$ like that is limiting your potential!」

521:t_008:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You can't let what's right before you bind you! If we live more freely, people... can go much further!」

521:t_009:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$サイコ・フレーム$$'s light has changed...!」

521:t_009:2.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Huh...! The spare shields are moving on their own!?」

521:t_010:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's impossible! What is this power!?」

521:t_010:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Did he control the shields with a $$サイコ・フィールド$$!?」

521:t_010:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「So this is the potential he shows us.」

521:t_010:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
(As $$バナージ$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities awaken, the $$ユニコーン$$ evolves, and at the same time, it makes $$バナージ$$ evolve...)

521:t_010:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
(This is... the true meaning... of a $$ガンダム$$...)

521:t_010:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I won't forgive you...! I won't forgive you, $$バナージ$$!」

521:t_010:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You rejected the Colonel! I'll kill you with my own hands!」

521:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Leave the rest to us!」

521:t_012:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're coming, $$シャア$$, $$アムロ$$!?」

521:t_012:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Go, $$シャア$$! I'll pin him down!」

521:t_012:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll settle things with the me inside you!」

521:t_013:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Ghh! Has the $$シナンジュ$$ reached its limit, too!?」

521:t_014:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is retreating.」

521:t_014:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Don't pursue them. Our first priority is restoring the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

521:t_014:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I did, in my own mind.」

521:t_014:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「At least I could feel that he's a different being from me... a me at the opposite extreme.」

521:t_014:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I probably won't be the one to stop him.」

521:t_014:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't go deciding you're satisfied all on your own.」

521:t_015:1.en:
$$クェス$$
「Don't tell me you're going to...!」

521:t_015:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I told you I'd settle things when $$シャア$$ returned.」

521:t_016:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「This is between me and $$ハマーン$$. Everyone, please stand back.」

521:t_016:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I understand. All units, return to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

521:t_016:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll watch this through and see how you choose to live.」

521:t_016:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Whatever the outcome, please accept it.」

521:t_016:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So this will bring one old conflict to an end...」

521:t_017:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「This is between me and $$ハマーン$$. Everyone, please stand back.」

521:t_017:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I understand. All units, return to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

521:t_017:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Whatever the outcome, please accept it.」

521:t_017:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So this will bring one old conflict to an end...」

521:t_019:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I'm sorry, $$ハマーン$$. I can't let you kill me yet.」

521:t_019:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I'll settle things in my own way! This is our final battle!」

521:t_020:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Do you have the right to decide that!?」

521:t_020:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Watching $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ$$, I felt... how important it is to give our feelings form.」

521:t_020:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ハマーン$$... Until now, I've taken you for granted.」

521:t_020:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「I selfishly assumed you'd understand everything without my putting it into words.」

521:t_020:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...You have far too many fantasies about women.」

521:t_020:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Remember, just as you want to rely on women, there are women who want to rely on you.」

521:t_020:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's true even of someone the world calls an iron woman.」

521:t_020:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Will you walk beside me, $$ハマーン$$?」

521:t_020:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I've been waiting all this time for you to say that.」

521:t_021:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're good, $$シャア$$! That's what I expect of you!」

521:t_021:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Are you afraid!? The $$赤い彗星$$ has certainly fallen far!」

521:t_021:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it. ...I want to talk to you.」

521:t_021:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Watching $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ$$, I felt... how important it is to give our feelings form.」

521:t_021:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ハマーン$$... Until now, I've taken you for granted.」
